name: Suiko Nishikori
source:
Upbeat and optimistic, Suiko Nishikori wants only two things in life, attending the prestigious school of Morning Glory Academy and fawning over hot male teachers. With his dreams of men and education coming true, Suiko has only one problem. None of his teachers are interested in him at all! With the help of some friends, town folks, and celestial beings, Suiko will begin his journey to promiscuity!

[From Kickstarter]
